summary: Keep collection sockets alive with protocol ping/pong and close blocked sends.

schema.detail: No database layout or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The existing collections v0 socket sends standard WebSocket Ping every eight seconds, answers client Ping with its payload, and closes a send that blocks for eight seconds. JSON frames, collection names and subscription bounds are unchanged. The real-socket control proves ping/pong without extra window reads; deployed old-client pairs have not been measured.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal daemon replacement restart. Existing clients reconnect for an authoritative snapshot.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; replacing the binary with the prior build restores the previous socket behavior.
